purpose: Repeatable selection of the real mobile journey tests; never interpret compilation or a large test count as release acceptance

android.isolation: Dedicated emulator with isolated QA app data. Never run against owner phone/prod app or clear other users/apps. Record installed app/test APK hashes, original screen/font settings, and a fresh three-digit run ID. Preserve logs/screenshots/results and restore original configuration after large-text runs. Do not replay a receipt whose outcome is uncertain.

core.scope: Real MainActivity routing, native IME/editor, profile/friend Signal send, Bot consent/send/reentry/errors/history, multiline draft before/after confirmed exchange, and landscape full rendered final line/caret without shrinking text. Identity, relay, billing and Bot transport are controlled.

domain.scope: Real sessions, model, encrypted vault, ownership, clock/order races, cancellation and cleanup; controlled transport/SDK.

speech.scope: Actual production bubble gestures and native AudioTrack lifecycle; no physical acoustic-quality claim.

preview_pairs.scope: One native test loops110 authored preview directions, not110 arbitrary-conversation cases. Inspect complete per-direction JSON, native playback and stop receipts.

android.verification: Inspect instrumentation test result codes, not just adb exit0. Require all selected tests complete with no failures/skip; inspect final screen geometry and artifacts. Narrow/enlarged UI must keep input and actions inside the native window minus IME.
android.landscape_regression: The friend and dedicated Bot journeys temporarily use1920x1080 while retaining current font scale; require full rendered line/caret, Back/Send target size and no toolbar/IME overlap, then restore the original size/rotation/accelerometer and exact draft. These tests failed the pre-fix product; corrected product must pass before acceptance.

incoming_reply_pixel_gate.inputs: Paired native PNG/XML captured by the actual friend journey, known reply text and retained draft. Requires host Tesseract eng + Pillow; unavailable tooling fails, never skips.
incoming_reply_pixel_gate.assertion: All expected fixture words must be visibly rendered inside the actual conversation scroll viewport above composer. Native paragraph coordinates alone are insufficient.
incoming_reply_pixel_gate.qualification: Positive032 readable capture passed; original035 native8PASS capture failed pixel gate. Keep these as distinct observations, not a relabeled JUnit result.
incoming_reply_pixel_gate.limits: Known English fixture only; does not assess arbitrary translation, emoji shape or acoustic quality.

ios.isolation: Separate native simulator and private QA bundle/keychain. Run two compiler jobs. DEBUG host uses actual view, owner/session and encrypted vault with controlled transport; do not copy its bundle/Auth/project overlays into release source.
ios.storekit: Local StoreKit transactions must pass readiness and assert environment Xcode. Domain/mock tests are separate evidence; real sandbox/server signature verification is another boundary.

limits: External OAuth and real share-sheet delivery must be established separately.
No-charge store transactions already completed must be reconciled, not repeated.
Do not publish or call the app ready while a user-facing journey failure remains.
